marc:datafield.marc:subfield: A blood-chilling tale about modern-day vampires unlikeany previously encountered, Blade is an action-packed thriller. The story of the ultimate vampire hunter, Blade (Wesley Snipes) is an immortal warrior who possesses the superhuman strength and evil cunning of a vampire but shares none of thei weanesses. Able to walk and stalk by night, Blade must confront his ultimate adversary, the omnipotent vampire overlord Deacon Frost (Stephen Dorff) intent on leading a secret nation to conquer mankind. Blade must use his awesome powers and razor-sharp weaponry like never before to prevent annihilation of the human race.
